(Japanese: ソルト Salt) is a recurring character who appears in Pokémon Horizons: The Series. He is the father of Ult and was the one to give him the Dusk Ball containing . According to Team Dragon Rampage, he is also a famous .

==History==
 
===Pre-series===
=== ===
In a flashback in Friends as Two, Me and You, he was shown giving Ult his , telling it that when the day comes that Ult fights to protect someone else, that is when it fights on his behalf.

In Mega Evolution - Ult, it was revealed that Ult lived part of his life homeless in the alleys of Lumiose City. Salt's current whereabouts and status are unknown.
